verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents several in-product AI features that turn customer data into insights and suggestions. Comply AI for Risk produces inherent and residual risk scores, treatments and justifications. Comply AI auto-generates infrastructure-as-code fixes for remediation, extracts answers from vendor SOC 2 reports, and generates SSPs and POA&Ms from real-time compliance data. Missing for 10: an in-product conversational assistant for querying your own data (the MCP server serves external clients, not the product UI), in-depth docs beyond marketing pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration of output quality.
